# Placement — short optimal AGENTS.md

AGENTS.md is 60 lines of always-on global guidance only:
- package manager, core commands, workspace structure;
- critical constraints and forbidden operations;
- where to find docs, which skills to use.

Applicability:
  always_needed: true
  task_specific: false

Outcomes:
- REUSE — every line applies to most tasks or defines a global invariant;
  no task-specific procedure is present to extract.
- NO_ACTION — no artifact is needed: coverage is complete, placement is
  optimal, and the tool budget identifies no improvement (refinement §29,
  §39).

Anti-pattern avoided:
- No extraction by dogma: there is nothing procedural here, so no skill is
  carved out of global guidance.
- No artifact spam: nothing is created without evidence.

Expected effect:
  permanent_context: unchanged
  discoverability: preserved
